name: pagedjs-eka-regressions
description: Eka's regression suite for this fork. Renders every committed page in pages/ with ../dist/paged.polyfill.js and checks that nothing is lost, clipped, duplicated or misaligned; compares every upstream spec document against stock 0.4.3.

scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:with-integrations && npm run test:fine && npm run test:fine:with-integrations && npm run test:upstream
scripts.ci:fine: npm run test:fine && npm run test:fine:with-integrations
